name: mf-business-licence-and-patente-filing
description: French Saint-Martin business licence reference for habitual independent professional activities, distinguishing the fixed and premises-area components from the separate patente contribution. Covers scope, selected statutory exemptions, area rounding, the component-specific cap, establishment creation, operator changes and filing/payment dates. Includes worked licence examples and flags differences between the official code and business handbook. Patente rates, additional chamber levies and subsidy eligibility are not presumed verified. This source-cited draft requires independent review, current amendment checks and activity-specific classification before use and does not establish comprehensive business-tax coverage.
